words.sense: Talks at excessive length about trivial matters, often wearying listeners
misconceptions: Length alone proves listeners are bored

words.sense: Very talkative, without implying triviality or tedium
misconceptions: Length alone proves listeners are bored

semantic_axes.description: Whether the scene turns on triviality of content.
Whether the scene turns on listener fatigue.

edges.boundary_rule: Garrulous speech drags on about unimportant details and tires listeners; loquacious speech is simply abundant.

misconceptions.M3: Length alone proves listeners are bored

chains.frame: Which word best describes Omar’s talking during the club meeting?

beats.text: Omar spoke for most of the meeting, explaining each proposal with energy.
beats.reason: The detail about talkative with useful content supports loquacious more strongly than garrulous.

beats.text: He spent the final twenty minutes listing unrelated details about his pencil collection while everyone checked the clock.
beats.reason: The detail about tedious, irrelevant digression supports garrulous more strongly than loquacious.

chains.feedback_short: Tedious, irrelevant digression makes garrulous the better description.
chains.feedback_deep: Initially, talkative with useful content points toward loquacious. The new detail, tedious, irrelevant digression, instead makes garrulous the stronger choice. Garrulous speech drags on about unimportant details and tires listeners; loquacious speech is simply abundant.
chains.contrast_rule: Garrulous wears listeners out; loquacious simply talks a lot.

hints.attention: Notice what fills the conversation and how others respond.
